AccountCloudConfig.title: AccountCloudConfig
AccountCloudConfig.description: Account-level cloud configuration synced across any phone logged into the same account: owner display name, Gemini API key pool, selected models, deleted models, and voice/auto-chat preferences.

ownerDisplayName.description: Account owner name announced in polite away replies

lastDeviceModel.description: Most recent device model that synced this account

apiKeysJson.description: Account-scoped JSON array of Gemini API keys

activeApiKeyId.description: Currently active API key entry ID

autoRotateApiKeys.description: Whether multi-key auto failover is enabled

liveModel.description: Selected Gemini Live audio model ID

agentModel.description: Selected Gemini Vision/Action agent model ID

deletedModels.description: Model IDs hidden/deleted by the account owner

PersonalDataEntry.title: PersonalDataEntry
PersonalDataEntry.description: User-saved personal facts ('আমার ডাটা') synced across all phones under this account.

title.description: Short topic or label (e.g. আমার নাম, ঠিকানা, পেশা)

content.description: Detailed personal fact or preferred answer

shareInAutoReply.description: Allow Auto-Reply AI to share this fact when asked

CloudRoutine.title: CloudRoutine
CloudRoutine.description: User-authored custom voice automation routine synced under this account.

CloudAskAiMessage.title: CloudAskAiMessage
CloudAskAiMessage.description: Saved Ask AI conversation message synced under this account.

/users/{userId}/account/{docId}.description: Account-level settings, owner display name, API key pool, selected models, and deleted models — restored automatically on any new phone.

/users/{userId}/personalData/{entryId}.description: Personal knowledge base entries ('আমার ডাটা') synced across devices for this account.

/users/{userId}/routines/{routineId}.description: Custom automation routines synced across devices for this account.

/users/{userId}/askAiMessages/{messageId.description: Saved Ask AI chat history messages synced across devices for this account.
